name: WARNING: Deli Cold Pasta Salad (Retrograded Resistant Starch & Raw Veggies)
whyItWorks: When pasta cools, its starch molecules recrystallize into Type 3 Resistant Starch (RS3), which completely resists digestion in the small intestine. Mixed with raw crunchy peppers, onions, and oily vinaigrette, it triggers severe gas bloating.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Always eat pasta warm and freshly cooked. Skip chilled pasta salads from delis or buffets.
